title: On your next visit the table still follows the remembered filter choice
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
  • You use the same browser throughout, not a private window (the dashboard keeps these choices in this browser only).
  • Technicians {Technician-A} and {Technician-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST Tech One and ZZAUTOTEST Tech Two) have clocked time at {Location-A} this month, so both are listed in the Technician filter of the Technician Efficiency chart.
  • Service advisors {Advisor-A} and {Advisor-B} (for example Admin ShopView and ZZAUTOTEST Advisor Two) have invoiced work with clocked time at {Location-A} this month, so both are listed in the Billing Efficiency chart.
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar.
  2. Click View details on Technician Efficiency.
  3. In the Technician filter keep only {Technician-A} ticked.
  4. Click View details on Billing Efficiency.
  5. In the Advisor filter choose {Advisor-A}.
  6. Close the browser tab.
  7. Open the site again in the same browser and click Dashboard in the top bar.
  8. Click View details on Technician Efficiency and read the chart and the Technician Efficiency table.
  9. Click View details on Billing Efficiency and read the chart and the Advisor Analysis table.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 8: The chart shows only {Technician-A}'s line, and the Technician Efficiency table lists only {Technician-A}.
  • Step 9: The chart shows only {Advisor-A}'s line, and the Advisor Analysis table lists only {Advisor-A}.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9580 (Story 8, Chart Filters), with SV-9578 (Story 6); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S8-R6 and S6-R16 (since version 42) and S8-R5a (added in version 44, saved on 13 Oct 2026 (13:37 UTC) by Chris Ward with the note "the table follows the chart filter (Ayesha)"; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-13); read 14 Oct 2026. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=43&selectedPageVersions=44. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S8-R6: “A tile's chart filter selection is remembered for that tile between visits.”
  • S8-R5a: “The table under the chart follows the same filter: it lists only the selected technicians, or only the selected advisor. With no advisor chosen it lists every advisor, as the chart does.”
  • S6-R16: “Every choice the dashboard remembers, the expanded tile, a chart's technician or advisor selection (S8-R6), the At Risk inactivity window (S5-R14), and the show-or-hide state of an embedded chart (S11-E1), is stored in the browser. It is therefore per browser and per device: it does not follow the user to another computer, another browser, or a private window, and it is not part of the user's account. Clearing browser data returns every one of them to its default.”
